Changes:
- Added explicit physical schema, material-specific friction, restitution, COM/fragility and honest mass/density priors.
- Updated reproducible meshes, GLB/Blend, collision pieces and calibrated-instance transforms.
- Computed part COM estimates from collision volume; corrected Blender inertial origins without moving canonical visuals.
- Reclassified opaque shell as polymer; refit visible extent.

Remaining:
- Photometric mismatch remains: illumination, baked label lighting and/or reflective/transmissive appearance need further calibration.
- Mass, COM, friction and restitution are unmeasured priors.
- No directly observed manipulation sequence verifies closure forces, thread pitch, flap limits or stiffness.
